name: two-factor-card
title: Two-factor card
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Verification card for a one-time code, with a countdown, alternate methods, and a success handoff.

meta.descriptionEs: Tarjeta para un código de un solo uso, con cuenta regresiva, métodos alternos y una vista de éxito.

examples.title: Verificación
examples.description: Cuenta regresiva, error y éxito. El código 246810 continúa.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px, RTL, separador, carga, error y éxito.

meta.usage:
<TwoFactorCard
  expiresIn={180}
  gradient
  onVerify={async (code) => code === "246810"}
  onContinue={() => router.push("/home")}
  methods={[{ id: "qr", label: "Scan QR code", onSelect: showQr }]}
/>

api.name: length / separator
api.description: Digit count. Default 6. separator draws a break at the midpoint, or a node you pass.

api.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
api.description: The code. Omit value for internal state. Digits only.

api.name: onVerify
api.description: Return false or throw to show the error. Otherwise the card crossfades to success. An incomplete code errors without calling it.

api.name: autoSubmit
api.description: Verify as soon as every slot is filled. Default false.

api.name: expiresIn / onExpire / onResend
api.description: Countdown in seconds. A polite live region speaks once per remaining minute and at zero. Zero shows Resend, which restores the countdown.

api.name: onContinue / successTitle
api.description: The success view hides the code, the timer, and the alternate methods.

api.name: onBack / onMenu
api.description: Optional header actions. Omitted buttons are not rendered.

api.name: methods
api.description: Footer actions. Defaults to Scan QR code and Use message. Pass [] to hide them.

api.name: gradient
api.description: Blends primary toward chart-2 on the main buttons. Default false.

api.name: labels
api.description: title, description, verify, continue, success, expiry, resend, and error strings default to English.

api.name: className / classNames
api.description: Root class and slot classes for the header, icon, title, description, slots, timer, submit, methods, and success view.

docs: Built on the input-otp primitive. otp-field is the field alone; this card is the verification step around it. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite input-otp or button. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. The digit pop and the error shake are skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. Visual inspiration is a Facebook reel by Design & Code With AV (2FA UI Upgrade). No code from that reel was used.
